settings.label: Community creativity
settings.text: We stock theINmag because we want this to be a place where creativity is part of the neighbourhood. The mag is filled with creations by real Aussie kids: art, stories, comics, jokes. Real kids, real ideas, in print. Come in and have a flick through.

settings.label: Local kids in print
settings.text: theINmag is a 120 page magazine made entirely by kids, and any kid can send in a creation. We stock it because we love the idea of a kid from around here opening it and finding their own creation inside. Can't beat that for inspiration!

settings.label: Off the screen
settings.text: Something truly wholesome for the counter, not another screen. theINmag is written, drawn and dreamt up by creative kids, printed in Australia, no ads. Pick one up, take it home, and watch it get passed around the table.

settings.label: One line
settings.text: The magazine for creative kids. No ads, just creativity.

settings.label: One line
settings.text: The magazine publishing creative Aussie kids.

settings.label: Long, warm
settings.text: We chose to stock theINmag because it is the kind of thing we want in our community. Every one of its 120 plus pages is made by kids. Art, stories, comics, jokes, big ideas, all theirs. It gives kids a real audience and a real reason to make things, and it shows them what other kids are making across the country. It is printed sustainably here in Australia with no ads. Come check it out. We're the exclusive stockists in our area!

settings.label: Long, practical
settings.text: theINmag is a print magazine made entirely by kids. Each issue is 120 plus pages of art, stories, comics, jokes and ideas, with no advertising. New issues come out in February, June and October. It is printed sustainably in Australia. Any kid can send in a creation through theinmag.com.au and have a chance of being published. We are the stockist for this area, so if you would like a copy, pop in or ask us to put one aside.

settings.label: Add to any post
settings.text: Your kid could be in the next issue. Send in a drawing, story, comic or joke at theinmag.com.au. Any kid, anywhere.
